abstract: ABSTRACT Today, there is a global effort to reduce greenhouse gas net emissions (GHGNE). For economic well‐being, it is important to identify low‐cost means of net emission offsets. Agriculture and forestry have received considerable attention as a means of supplying emissions offsets, as they contribute nearly 20% of global emissions. However, given that other sources of emissions also present opportunities for reducing GHGNE, the issue of comparative offset costs becomes important. This paper examines the offset costs associated with reducing net carbon dioxide equivalent emissions in agriculture and highlights the relative costs and associated cost components. We discuss an approach for estimating the per‐tonne GHGNE cost and formulate expressions for the cost to buyers, payments to sellers, and the gap in between in the context of a potential carbon market. Case studies are conducted to estimate the gap for different situations. We believe differences in claimable versus saleable GHGNE quantities and market transaction costs, in part, explain the large variation in observed prices paid for different emission offset actions.
abstract_zh: 摘要 当前，全球正致力于减少温室气体净排放（GHGNE）。为了经济福祉，识别低成本的净排放抵消手段至关重要。农业和林业作为提供排放抵消的途径受到了广泛关注，因为它们贡献了全球近20%的排放量。然而，鉴于其他排放源也提供了减少GHGNE的机会，比较抵消成本的问题变得尤为重要。本文考察了农业中减少净二氧化碳当量排放所涉及的抵消成本，并强调了相对成本及其相关成本构成。我们讨论了一种估算每吨GHGNE成本的方法，并在潜在碳市场的背景下，为买方成本、卖方支付以及两者之间的差距制定了表达式。通过案例研究，我们估算了不同情境下的这一差距。我们认为，可申报与可销售的GHGNE数量之间的差异以及市场交易成本，部分解释了不同排放抵消行动所观察到的价格差异。
journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: The Price Gap in Agriculture‐Based Greenhouse Gas Offset Markets
title_zh: 农业温室气体抵消市场中的价格差距

abstract: The manuscript records of the Royal African Company show that the Company paid African chiefs for access to trade along the caravan routes on the Gold Coast in the seventeenth century. This paper documents and examines these payments. Using an event study, I establish that after the Glorious Revolution in 1688 when the Company's monopoly in trade over West Africa became uncertain, it resulted in greater competition from other English merchants, making the Company increase its payments to African chiefs whose cooperation was essential to deter other English merchants from competing with the Company. The highest‐ranking chiefs received the highest value of payments per capita. Company records show that firearms (including gunpowder), alcohol, and an expensive type of cloth were the most sought‐after types of payment, and head chiefs received most of these items.
abstract_zh: 皇家非洲公司的档案记录显示，该公司在十七世纪向黄金海岸 caravan 路线上的非洲酋长支付费用以获取贸易通道。本文记录并考察了这些支付行为。通过事件研究法，我发现在1688年光荣革命后，该公司在西非贸易中的垄断地位变得不确定，导致其他英国商人的竞争加剧，从而使公司增加了对非洲酋长的支付，因为他们的合作对于阻止其他英国商人与公司竞争至关重要。地位最高的酋长获得了最高的人均支付价值。公司记录显示，火器（包括火药）、酒精和一种昂贵的布料是最受欢迎的支付物品，而首领酋长获得了这些物品中的大部分。
title: Competition and payments to African chiefs on the Gold Coast during the slave trade, 1679‒1704
title_zh: 1679‒1704年奴隶贸易期间黄金海岸的竞争与对非洲酋长的支付

abstract: One of the key recommendations from the International Energy Agency Global Commission on People-Centred Clean Energy Transitions meeting is to integrate gender, equality, and social considerations into energy transition policies. The majority of the population in Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) currently lacks access to clean, modern and reliable energy, prompting numerous policies aimed at improving universal energy access in the region. SSA’s energy access deficit disproportionately impacts women, many of whom spend substantial productive hours on unpaid tasks like searching for and collecting firewood. This study investigates whether universal access to clean, modern, and reliable energy fosters gender equality in SSA. In particular, the analysis focuses on electrification and clean cooking technologies’ impact on gender inequality, using data from 41 SSA countries spanning 2000 to 2022. The findings based on the Panel Corrected Standard Error model reveal that electrification and clean cooking technologies contribute significantly to decreasing gender inequality in SSA. These results remain consistent across income groups and are robust when addressing endogeneity with Lewbel’s two-stage least-squares estimator and accounting for distributional heterogeneity via the method of moment quantile regression. The policy implication of our findings is that energy policies that support universal energy accessibility could effectively promote gender equality in SSA.
abstract_zh: 国际能源署以人为本的清洁能源转型全球委员会会议提出的关键建议之一，是将性别、平等和社会考量纳入能源转型政策。撒哈拉以南非洲（SSA）的大多数人口目前缺乏清洁、现代且可靠的能源获取途径，这促使该地区出台了众多旨在改善普遍能源获取的政策。SSA的能源获取缺口对女性的影响尤为严重，许多女性将大量生产性时间花费在寻找和收集柴火等无偿任务上。本研究探讨了普遍获取清洁、现代且可靠能源是否有助于促进SSA的性别平等。具体而言，分析聚焦于电气化和清洁烹饪技术对性别不平等的影响，使用了2000年至2022年间41个SSA国家的数据。基于面板校正标准误模型的发现表明，电气化和清洁烹饪技术显著有助于减少SSA的性别不平等。这些结果在不同收入群体中保持一致，并在使用Lewbel两阶段最小二乘估计器处理内生性以及通过矩分位数回归方法考虑分布异质性时依然稳健。我们研究结论的政策含义是，支持普遍能源获取的能源政策能有效促进SSA的性别平等。
title: Electrification, clean cooking technologies and gender inequality: policy insight from Sub-Saharan Africa
title_zh: 电气化、清洁烹饪技术与性别不平等：来自撒哈拉以南非洲的政策启示

abstract: Using panel data from 61 countries, this study tests whether economic complexity influences stock market volatility. The results show that countries with more diverse and unique products (i.e. higher economic complexity) tend to experience higher asset-price stability. This relationship is driven by emerging market economies. Additional tests show that the benefit of lower volatility kicks in after economic complexity breaches a certain threshold, below which the gains are either lower or insignificant. The results are robust in response to concerns about endogeneity and to alternative measures of volatility. Further analysis reveals that trade complexity has a greater influence on stock market stability than technology and research complexities. Finally, with the COVID-19 stock market shock as a backdrop, the analysis shows that emerging markets with higher economic complexity had smaller stock price drops.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用61个国家的面板数据，检验经济复杂性是否影响股市波动性。结果显示，产品更为多样且独特的国家（即经济复杂性较高）往往经历更高的资产价格稳定性。这一关系主要由新兴市场经济体驱动。进一步测试表明，经济复杂性突破某一阈值后，降低波动性的益处才开始显现，低于该阈值时，收益要么较小，要么不显著。结果在应对内生性问题和波动性替代度量方面保持稳健。深入分析揭示，贸易复杂性对股市稳定性的影响大于技术复杂性和研究复杂性。最后，以COVID-19股市冲击为背景，分析显示经济复杂性较高的新兴市场股市跌幅较小。
title: Does economic complexity tame the stock markets? International evidence
title_zh: 经济复杂性是否驯服了股票市场？国际证据
